description: Pull teammates' docs and show open handoffs at session start; publish doc edits when a turn ends. Both do nothing in repos without an apl docs branch.

hooks.command: command -v apl >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'The apl CLI is not installed, so docs in .apl/ are unavailable. Tell the user to install it with: bun i -g @ghmeier/agent-plan@latest'; exit 0; }; apl hook session-start
command -v apl >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; apl hook stop >/dev/null
